about: The Veeam Service Channel test: per product, the service that hosts its gRPC server, the named pipe the channel uses (empty when not known), the log folder and the logs to read; and the log lines that tell how the channel did, each with its reading. The health call is the standard grpc.health.v1.Health/Check request for the whole server (source grpc-health), which reads the service's state and changes nothing; its URL is added to a health row that is not Pass. observed_on names the evidence a product's entry was read from; a pattern with observed false comes from the gRPC status code guide and was not seen in a Veeam log yet.

patterns.name: gRPC service started
patterns.reading: The service started its gRPC host.

patterns.name: gRPC service stopped
patterns.reading: The service stopped its gRPC host; clients cannot connect until it starts again.

patterns.name: Pipe opened to authenticated users
patterns.reading: The service opened its pipe to authenticated users.

patterns.name: Client channel started
patterns.reading: A client process started its channel to the service.

patterns.name: Failed to connect with the backup service
all_of: Failed to connect with the backup service
patterns.reading: A client could not reach the service's pipe: the service was stopped, starting or not answering. It is logged every 30 seconds while it lasts.

patterns.name: Connection to the service timed out
patterns.reading: The client's connection to the service pipe timed out before the call started.

patterns.name: Call deadline exceeded
patterns.reading: The client connected, but the service did not answer the call in time: it was busy or blocked.

patterns.name: Request to the backup service failed
all_of: Failed to send the request to Veeam Backup Service
patterns.reading: The error the user interface shows after a failed call.

patterns.name: Connection teardown in the gRPC host
patterns.reading: Teardown noise from the service's gRPC host, also seen on healthy machines; it matters only when frequent.

patterns.name: Unavailable
patterns.reading: The server was not reachable or the connection dropped.

patterns.name: Unauthenticated
patterns.reading: The server rejected the caller's identity.

patterns.name: Permission denied
patterns.reading: The server refused the caller's rights.

patterns.name: Certificate not trusted
patterns.reading: A TLS channel's certificate was not trusted; the TLS Handshake tool shows the certificate.
